title: fpp: Fix mCRC calculation
description:
Conversations start at SMD-S and are continued with SMD-C frames
Added CRC information to proto_data of conversation for mCRC calculation
Continue checksum calculation for faulty fragments
Reassembly information added to info column
Reworked packet_direction

This fix contains quite many changes to the packet fpp dissector
The calculation of checksums was not implemented according to specification. We discovered this bug when analysing data from a TSN-switch.

Here are the changes in more detail:
- Calculation of mCRC moved to `dissect_preemption`
- Added function `get_packet_direction` to return packet_direction enum value
- struct `_fpp_ctx_t` now contains the current CRC value and a map with old CRC values
  Entries of this map are added during the first pass of the dissector and read during any following pass
  This way we always have access to the CRC of the current conversation for this specific fragment
- During the first pass a new conversation is started at every SMD-S fragment and SMD-C fragments continue the conversation
  During any other pass, the conversation is used to retrieve the CRC value at this point for SMD-C fragments
- Extended COL_INFO information
  "Reassembled in " is shown when reassembly was successful
  Corrupted SMD-S are marked as such
